A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same diagnostic study of iterative RAG. Their main text, figures, tables, equations, and complete appendices are readable and support reliable comparison despite repagination.

before.justification: V3 reports original evaluations of eleven LLMs on ChemKGMultiHopQA, including accuracy, token usage, a Gold+CoT ablation, and diagnostic analyses.

after.justification: V4 retains these original experimental results in Tables 1–3 and the main-text and appendix analyses.

M1.justification: The training-free controller, five-step retrieval budget, partial-answer state, curated evidence history, and answer composition procedure remain unchanged. The revised appendix prompt concerns diagnostic evaluation.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same one-to-four-hop chemistry questions from ChemKGMultiHopQA. The alternative datasets in Table S5 remain dataset-selection discussion, without additional benchmark evaluations.

E2.justification: Tables 1–2 retain the same eleven-model comparison and Gold+CoT comparisons for GPT-4o and Claude 3.7 Sonnet Standard and Thinking. The expanded discussion introduces no additional evaluated comparator.

E3.justification: Figure S8 changes the hop-coverage cutoff for labeling overconfident finalization from below 0.7 to below 0.8, matching the existing definition in Section 5.2.3. This revises a reported diagnostic setting; the PDFs do not establish that evaluations were rerun.

E4.justification: The Gold+CoT ablation, failure-mode analyses, case studies, and appendix context-length analyses retain the same analytical questions and plotted/tabulated evidence. Section 6 adds interpretation of existing analyses.

E5.justification: The uncertainty-reporting practices, t-tests, and error-bar conventions are unchanged, with no added run-count or seed information. The revised accuracy dispersion is a numerical correction rather than a change in statistical procedure.

E6.justification: Section 4 changes 80.89±5.8% to 80.89±5.08%. Section 4.5 corrects unanswered-by-all totals from 367/78/25 to 356/73/21 for No Context/Gold Context/Iterative RAG, with corresponding hop-specific corrections matching the unchanged Figure 6. Tables and model rankings are unchanged; Section 7 still reports ±5.8%.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(5), the damage-index definition, and the main mathematical metric definitions remain unchanged. Figure S8's cutoff correction aligns its operational prompt with the existing overconfidence definition; no theoretical reasoning or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract explicitly limits the central finding to the evaluation's experimental setup, and the abstract and conclusion add scientific-domain qualifications. The principal claim that iterative RAG can outperform oracle static evidence is retained.

C2.justification: Section 6 adds an explicit interpretation separating reasoning capacity, evidence quality, and their synchronization, using existing comparisons. It also clarifies cross-hop distraction within oracle evidence and the operational limitations of Gold Context and Gold+CoT as diagnostic upper bounds.

D1.justification: The abstract's code-and-results hyperlink changes from an anonymous repository to the named GitHub repository Matroid1998/Iterative-rag. Figure S8 also corrects the supplied diagnostic prompt's coverage threshold. Other implementation details are retained.

R1.justification: The bibliography, related-work discussion, and extended literature review retain the same works and research relationships. The scientific-domain novelty qualification added to the abstract was already explicit in the introduction.

P1.justification: V4 expands Section 6 with several explanatory paragraphs, makes scattered grammatical and terminology corrections, and updates affiliation and publication text. The overall section sequence and narrative structure remain intact.

P2.justification: V4 adds a TMLR running header and an OpenReview line, with reflow of the conclusion, references, and appendix floats. Existing figures and tables retain their designs and membership; several appendix displays change placement.

improvement.justification: V4 improves internal consistency by aligning Section 4.5 with Figure 6 and Figure S8 with the main diagnostic definition. More explicit claim boundaries and the expanded discussion improve interpretation of the retained evidence. The gains are limited, and the dispersion correction remains incomplete because Section 7 still reports ±5.8% while Section 4 reports ±5.08%.
